exposure.needed: whether the cert-manager-managed Kubernetes Ingress path whose pathType changed (e.g. during ingress-based ACME challenge solving) is exercised at runtime

consequence.statement: Ingresses that cert-manager creates now use pathType Exact instead of ImplementationSpecific, so path matching by the ingress controller may work differently.
consequence.remediation: Check that your ingress controller handles Exact pathType Ingresses created by cert-manager as expected.

assertion.statement: Change of the Kubernetes Ingress `pathType` from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact` for a reliable handling of ingress controllers and enhanced security

evidence.excerpt: - Change of the Kubernetes Ingress `pathType` from `ImplementationSpecific` to `Exact` for a reliable handling of ingress controllers and enhanced security. ([`#7767`](https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/pull/7767), [`@sspreitzer`](https://github.com/sspreitzer))
